generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1; never NULL; unique per table; PK columns are excluded from DISTINCT/GROUP/ORDER shaping so uniqueness is preserved.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Copy an existing parent primary-key value from the parent keys actually inserted in this instance; 10% of rows get NULL when the column is nullable; ensure at least one parent row has no child and at least one child row has NULL FK; re-verify after PK dedup.
generic_sampling_rules.int_numeric: Uniform integer in [1, 100] unless a per-column exception gives a tighter range; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real in [1990.0, 2010.0] with one decimal; never NULL when NOT NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Pick from a small pool of 8-12 distinct plausible strings; 20-40% duplicate share; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Pick from a pool of 10-15 distinct person/place names; 20-40% duplicate share; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Pick uniformly from the enum values listed in per_column_exceptions; 20-40% duplicate share; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_like_variant: For LIKE/equality literals, include the exact literal, a lowercase variant, an uppercase variant, and one near-variant (e.g. 'glish' for 'English'); 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_boundary: For comparison literals, include the exact literal and one lexicographic step on each side; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_wl_record: Format 'W-L' with W,L integers 0-9; 20-40% duplicate share; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_years: Format 'N (YYYY-YYYY, ...)' with N 1-10; 20-40% duplicate share; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Every nullable column gets at least one NULL row per instance; share 5-10%; planted NULLs are preserved through semantic rules (three-valued logic).
generic_sampling_rules.distinct_duplicates: Every DISTINCT-target non-PK column gets 20-50% duplicate share.
generic_sampling_rules.order_ties: Every ORDER-target column gets at least two rows tied at the first rank.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: Every GROUP-target non-PK column gets groups of size 1, 2 and >=3.
